A COUNTRY OF DIFFERENT PACES

Match the city to the weekend you want.

Germany rewards a focused first choice. Berlin, Munich and Hamburg each create a different kind of break; do not try to connect distant cities without checking the actual rail time and arrival logistics.

City or region?

Start with one city, then add a nearby landscape only when the connection genuinely improves the trip. Check official city tourism and rail information for your dates.

Build around one anchor

Choose one museum, neighbourhood, food or waterfront experience, then keep an open block for the city to surprise you.
